title: Darwin-Claw: Environment-Adaptive Experience Consolidation for Recursively Self-Evolving Agents

paragraphs.en: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities across complex tasks, they predominantly operate in isolated sessions, lacking the ability to continually learn from historical interactions or adapt to user-specific environments. Existing self-evolution paradigms often indiscriminately inject raw interaction trajectories into memory or skill modules, leading to obscured behavioral patterns and compromised update controllability. Furthermore, as foundational LLM reasoning improves, the bottleneck for agentic evolution shifts from accumulating generic knowledge to effectively managing situational experience. To address this, we propose Darwin-Claw , an environment-adaptive self-evolving framework that systematically distills episodic experiences to drive the comprehensive evolution of operational skills and durable memory. Theoretically grounded in an iterative agent-actor and evolver-critic co-adaptation, Darwin-Claw introduces a Hierarchical Experience Consolidation System that extracts fine-grained error attributions and generalizes them into dynamically updated prototype vectors. This structured situational experience serves as interaction patches for context-sensitive perception and explicit optimization signals for skill refinement. Practically, Darwin-Claw is a readily deployable, automated framework compatible with mainstream agent systems without requiring manual curation. Extensive experiments on WildClawBench demonstrate that Darwin-Claw yields substantial performance improvements, establishing a controllable and stable pathway for the continual, user-centric adaptation of autonomous agents in real-world ecosystems.

paragraphs.en: By interacting with complex and dynamic environments, large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated impressive capabilities across a broad spectrum of sophisticated tasks, including web navigation, vibe coding, healthcare monitoring, and deep research [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . paragraphs.en: Therefore, self-evolving agent systems have recently emerged as a prominent research direction, aiming to leverage recurrent interaction experience through internal learning loops to support continual, user-centric adaptation and refinement. Most existing self-evolution paradigms directly use contrasted user interaction trajectories as conditioning signals to distill long-term memory or overwrite practical skills. However, indiscriminately injecting heterogeneous experiences without explicit attribution into designated modules can not only obscure the agent’s behavioral patterns, but also introduce substantial challenges to update controllability. The absence of effective mechanisms for controlled updating further compromises both the stability of the evolutionary trajectory and the validity of the acquired updates. Furthermore, as large language models continue to improve in reasoning and planning, and as external tool libraries become increasingly comprehensive, the relative contribution and marginal utility of cognitive and behavioral experience may diminish substantially. Under this trend, a core challenge for self-evolving agents is no longer merely how to accumulate generic experience, but rather how to systematically model, dynamically store, and efficiently retrieve situational experience, thereby enabling rapid self-evolution and effective adaptation to specific user environments.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，自我演化的智能体系统最近已成为一个重要的研究方向，其目标是通过内部学习循环利用反复的交互经验，以支持持续且以用户为中心的适应与优化。 大多数现有的自我演化范式直接将对比的用户交互轨迹用作条件信号，以提炼长期记忆或覆盖实际技能。 然而，在没有明确归因的情况下，将异质经验无差别地注入指定模块，不仅可能模糊智能体的行为模式，还会给更新的可控性带来重大挑战。 缺乏有效的受控更新机制，进一步削弱了演化轨迹的稳定性和所获取更新的可靠性。 此外，随着大语言模型在推理和规划方面的持续改进，以及外部工具库日益完善，认知和行为经验的相对贡献与边际效用可能会显著下降。 在这一趋势下，自我演化智能体的核心挑战已不再仅仅是如何积累通用经验，而是如何系统地建模、动态存储并高效检索情境性经验，从而实现快速自我演化，并有效适应特定的用户环境。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by this, we turn to the idea of accumulating environment-adaptive experience to facilitate agentic self-evolution. We propose Darwin-Claw , an environment-adaptive agentic self-evolving framework that automatically distills episodic experience to drive the comprehensive evolution of operational skills and durable memory.

paragraphs.en: Theoretically , the agentic self-evolution is grounded in the iterative co-adaptation between agent-actor trajectories and evolver-critic trajectories. Darwin-Claw views self-evolution not as parameter update in isolation, but as a closed-loop process in which interaction failures are first attributed, abstracted, and consolidated into implicit environment prototypes, and are then transformed into structured experience that supports both immediate behavioral correction and long-horizon capability growth. Specifically, the proposed Hierarchical Experience Consolidation System extracts fine-grained error attributions from user interaction trajectories and generalizes them into dynamically updated prototype vectors that organize situational experience across diverse environments. Built on this substrate, Experience-Driven Agentic Holistic Evolution treats consolidated situational experience as interaction patches for improving context-sensitive perception, while distilling operational experience into explicit optimization signals for external skills. Moreover, once environment-specific experience becomes sufficiently accumulated and refined, it can be elevated into a dreaming condition that further reshapes the agent’s long-term memory. Darwin-Claw establishes a principled theory of self-evolving agents in which situational experience serves as the core medium linking environmental adaptation, skill refinement, and memory formation.
paragraphs.zh: 理论上，智能体的自我演化基于智能体-执行者轨迹与演化器-评论家轨迹之间的迭代协同适应。 Darwin-Claw 将自我演化视为一种闭环过程，而非孤立的参数更新：首先对交互失败进行归因、抽象和整合，形成隐式的环境原型，随后将其转化为结构化经验，以支持即时行为修正和长期能力成长。 具体而言，所提出的分层经验整合系统从用户交互轨迹中提取精细的错误归因，并将其泛化为动态更新的原型向量，从而组织跨不同环境的情境经验。 基于这一基础，经验驱动的智能体整体演化系统将整合后的情境经验视为用于提升上下文感知能力的交互补丁，同时将操作经验提炼为明确的外部技能优化信号。 此外，一旦特定环境下的经验积累和精炼达到足够程度，它便可升华为一种“梦境”状态，进一步重塑智能体的长期记忆。 Darwin-Claw 建立了一种关于自我演化智能体的理论框架，其中情境经验是连接环境适应、技能精炼与记忆形成的核心媒介。

paragraphs.en: Practically , Darwin-Claw is designed as a general, environment-adaptive evolutionary framework that is compatible with a wide range of mainstream agent systems, incorporating OpenClaw, Claude-Code, Codex, and Hermes. Specifically, experience consolidation driven by runtime interaction without manual curation or explicit user intervention. Hierarchical experiential attribution supports efficient vector retrieval from a locally stored experience pool to enhance perception. Episodic experience-driven memory distillation and skill updates are generated through open-ended reasoning eliminating reliance on predefined rules. Furthermore, experimental results on WildClawBench demonstrate that Darwin-Claw yields substantial improvements across tasks, highlighting the effectiveness of stable and efficient self-evolution for building continuously improving agent systems in real-world scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 实际上，Darwin-Claw 被设计为一个通用且能自适应环境的进化框架，与多种主流智能体系统兼容，包括 OpenClaw、Claude-Code、Codex 和 Hermes。 具体而言，它通过运行时交互驱动经验整合，无需人工整理或用户的显式干预。 层级化的经验归因机制支持从本地存储的经验池中高效检索向量，从而增强感知能力。 通过开放式推理生成基于事件性经验的记忆蒸馏和技能更新，无需依赖预定义规则。 此外，在 WildClawBench 上的实验结果表明，Darwin-Claw 在各种任务中均实现了显著提升，凸显了稳定高效的自我进化机制在构建持续优化的智能体系统于真实场景中的有效性。

paragraphs.en: We propose Darwin-Claw, an environment-adaptive experience-driven agentic self-evolving framework. Darwin-Claw leverages the iterative interplay between agent actor trajectories and evolver critic trajectories to enhance the agent’s perception of diverse user interaction environments, while further driving stable self-evolution through contextual experience. Hierarchical Experience Consolidation System (Section. 2.2.1 ) extracts error attributions from user interaction trajectories and further generalizes them into implicitly updated environment prototype vectors, which are then used to categorize and consolidate situational experience. Experience-Driven Agentic Holistic Evolution (Section. 2.2.2 and 2.2.3 ) leverages situational experience as interaction patches that can be directly provided to the agent to improve perceptual responses, while distilled operational experience is used to explicitly optimize external skills. Once experience related to specific environmental factors has been sufficiently accumulated and refined, it can further serve as a dreaming condition to influence the agent’s long-term memory.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Darwin-Claw——一个能够适应环境、以经验驱动的智能体自我演化框架。 Darwin-Claw 利用智能体执行者轨迹与演化器评论者轨迹之间的迭代互动，增强智能体对多样化用户交互环境的感知，并通过情境经验进一步促进稳定的自我演化。 分层经验整合系统（第 2.2.1 节）从用户交互轨迹中提取错误归因，并将其泛化为隐式更新的环境原型向量，随后用于对情境经验进行分类和整合。 以经验驱动的智能体整体演化（第 2.2.2 节和第 2.2.3 节）将情境经验作为可直接提供给智能体的交互片段，以提升其感知响应；同时，蒸馏出的操作经验则用于显式优化外部技能。 一旦与特定环境因素相关的经验得到充分积累和提炼，它便可进一步作为“梦境”条件，影响智能体的长期记忆。

paragraphs.en: Phase 1: User Interaction Trajectory Parsing. To minimize computational overhead, the system incrementally processes only new session traces generated since the last evolution cycle. It parses the raw trace τ \tau to identify Skill Invocations (SIs) —complete segments encompassing skill reading, tool execution, and observation. paragraphs.en: Phase 2: Experience Extraction via LLM Triage. Analyzing all traces is computationally prohibitive. The LLM acts as a filter to determine whether a trace contains learnable behavioral or perceptual patterns ( e.g. , error recovery, tool substitution, repetitive retries, or efficiency bottlenecks). Routine or flawless executions are particularly discarded. Additionally, For traces exhibiting strong learning signals, the LLM generates a structured Experience Unit (EU) . Each EU encapsulates specific trigger conditions, keywords, and actionable handling strategies (categorized into exploit or explore subtypes).
paragraphs.zh: 第二阶段：通过 LLM 筛选提取经验。 分析所有痕迹在计算上成本过高，难以实施。 LLM 充当过滤器，判断某条痕迹是否包含可学习的行为或感知模式（例如错误恢复、工具替换、重复重试或效率瓶颈）。 常规或完美无瑕的执行过程会被特别排除。 此外，对于表现出强烈学习信号的痕迹，LLM 会生成一个结构化的经验单元（EU）。 每个 EU 都封装了特定的触发条件、关键词和可操作的应对策略（分为“利用”或“探索”子类型）。

paragraphs.en: To ensure the reliability of the externalized policy, we introduce a rigorous validation mechanism for deploying generated episodic experiences, grounded in principles of causal inference.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保外化策略的可靠性，我们引入了一种严格的验证机制，用于部署生成的情节性经验，该机制以因果推断原则为基础。

paragraphs.en: Causal Attribution: When a new EU is tentatively applied, a two-step LLM pipeline evaluates subsequent traces. It first determines the relevance (whether the new trace hits the EU’s context). More importantly, it performs causal attribution : it assesses whether the observed change in the agent’s performance is a direct causal result of reading the EU, or merely coincidental.
paragraphs.zh: 因果归因：当初步应用一个新的欧盟时，一个两步式的大型语言模型流程会评估后续的痕迹。 它首先确定相关性（即新的痕迹是否触及了欧盟的上下文）。 更重要的是，它会进行因果归因：评估智能体表现的变化是直接因阅读欧盟而产生的结果，还是仅仅巧合。

paragraphs.en: Validated patches are deployed by writing EUs as inline blocks directly into the corresponding SKILL.md files. To preserve prompt quality and prevent performance degradation caused by information overload, the system adopts a lifecycle evolutionary management mechanism. Specifically, each skill is subject to strict slot limits ( e.g. , six active slots, divided into three exploit and three explore slots) to control context complexity. Within this framework, each EU progresses through a state-machine lifecycle: new patches first enter a probationary Nursery with limited capacity and a Time-To-Live (TTL), where they must accumulate positive evidence ( e > 0 e>0 ) to be promoted; promoted EUs then occupy regular Active slots, where they are retained or replaced through competitive selection based on performance; finally, EUs that consistently produce negative effects ( e < 0 e<0 ) or exceed their TTL are automatically evicted and archived, while users may also manually pin or evict specific EUs. Through this competitive, experience-driven evolutionary process, the framework ensures that the agent’s externalized memory preserves only the most valuable and causally effective strategies, thereby enabling recursively holistic self-evolution without modifying the underlying model parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 通过直接将 EU 作为内联块写入相应的 SKILL.md 文件来部署已验证的补丁。 为保持提示质量并防止信息过载导致的性能下降，系统采用了一种生命周期演化管理机制。 具体而言，每项技能都受到严格的槽位限制（例如，六个活跃槽位，分为三个利用槽位和三个探索槽位），以控制上下文复杂度。 在此框架内，每个 EU 都会经历一个状态机生命周期：新补丁首先进入容量有限且设有存活时间（TTL）的试用期“孵化区”，必须在此积累正向证据（e > 0）才能被升级；升级后的 EU 随后占据常规“活跃”槽位，根据性能通过竞争性选择决定保留或替换；最后，持续产生负面效果（e < 0）或超出 TTL 的 EU 会被自动清除并归档，同时用户也可手动固定或清除特定的 EU。 通过这种以经验驱动的竞争性演化过程，该框架确保智能体的外化记忆仅保留最具价值且具有因果有效性的策略，从而在不修改底层模型参数的情况下实现递归式整体自我演化。

paragraphs.en: We first evaluate on WildClawBench [ 6 ] whether skill self-evolution can consistently improve task scores across diverse real-world scenarios, spanning code intelligence, search and retrieval, creative synthesis, productivity workflows, safety alignment, and social interaction (Section 3.2 ). We then evaluate the proposed skill self-evolution approach on the iterative auto-research LLM optimization tasks based on RSIBench [ 7 ] , with a particular focus on whether it offers significant advantages in the efficiency and stability of experiential learning (Section 3.3 ).

paragraphs.en: In this section, we conduct holistic analyses to reveal the detailed task distribution of the agentic benchmark, demonstrate the performance advantages of Darwin-Claw across diverse real-world application scenarios, and provide quantitative analyses of adaptive experience accumulation and skill expansion in dynamic environments. Concretely, we evaluate GPT-5.5 under the OpenClaw harness on the diverse human-authored, bilingual, and multimodal tasks in WildClawBench [ 6 ] . As presented in Table 1 , Darwin-Claw demonstrates consistently superior performance over the baseline across all evaluation dimensions. In terms of average score, Darwin-Claw achieves substantial gains in overall performance ( + 24.1 % +24.1\% ), with particularly strong improvements on web tasks ( + 27.3 % +27.3\% ), tool-use tasks ( + 31.6 % +31.6\% ), reasoning-intensive tasks ( + 22.7 % +22.7\% ), and long-horizon tasks ( + 23.8 % +23.8\% ). This advantage also remains robust across increasing levels of task difficulty: the success rate improves by + 18.5 % +18.5\% on easy tasks, + 23.6 % +23.6\% on medium tasks, + 29.4 % +29.4\% on hard tasks, and + 33.2 % +33.2\% on extreme tasks. These results indicate that Darwin-Claw generalizes effectively to heterogeneous real-world scenarios requiring compositional decision-making, cross-domain adaptability, and sustained execution over extended interaction horizons. Moreover, the ablation study further confirms the importance of each core component, as removing hierarchical consolidation, prototype memory, or dual usage all leads to clear performance degradation relative to the full model. Taken together, these findings demonstrate that Darwin-Claw effectively transforms episodic interactions into structured situational experience, yielding more controllable, stable, and continual adaptation in realistic multi-task agent environments.

paragraphs.en: We evaluated the data-driven auto-research application from RSIBench-Data [ 7 ] , primarily based on the Qwen3.5-35B-A3B base model [ 18 ] with post-training enhancement via supervised fine-tuning (SFT). The agent leverages a fixed technology stack to select data filtering strategies and training hyperparameters for each optimization round, and can autonomously decide when to terminate the optimization. We adopted two widely used harnesses, Claude Code and Codex, paired with powerful closed-source models including Claude Opus-4.8, Claude Sonnet-5, GPT-5.6-terra, and GPT-5.6-sol. Previous methods mainly rely on offline large language models to extract structured reports, which are then passed to the agent as references for iterative training optimization. In contrast, our approach achieves self-optimizing iteration of the agent’s capabilities in specific scenarios through experience deposition and skill insertion. As shown in Table 2 , the proposed skill-based evolving approach successfully uncovers better post-training performance than the base model in 19 of 24 agentic auto-research tasks. In particular, our method achieves absolute performance gains of 32.00, 15.28, and 15.08 percentage points over the original base model on SWE-V, AIME, and Terminal-Bench 2.0, respectively. Moreover, skill-based evolving approach consistently outperforms context-passing evolving approach across all six benchmarks, increasing average performance from 28.42% to 31.91%. Notably, the proposed method avoids the performance degradation observed with context passing on GPQA Diamond. The relative gains are particularly pronounced on SWE-P and Terminal-Bench 2.0, where average performance improves by 68.8% and 34.1%, respectively. Experimental findings suggest that continually accumulating operational experience to improve skills is particularly effective for tasks requiring complex procedural reasoning and tool interaction. The solid self-improvement observed in the auto-research scenario further demonstrates that distilling feedback from each iteration into the continually enriched skill experience provides an effective and reusable mechanism for adaptation.

sents.zh: 先前的方法主要依赖离线大型语言模型提取结构化报告，然后将这些报告作为参考传递给智能体，用于迭代训练优化。

sents.en: In contrast, our approach achieves self-optimizing iteration of the agent’s capabilities in specific scenarios through experience deposition and skill insertion.
sents.zh: 相比之下，我们的方法通过经验沉淀和技能注入，在特定场景中实现了智能体能力的自我优化迭代。

sents.en: As shown in Table 2 , the proposed skill-based evolving approach successfully uncovers better post-training performance than the base model in 19 of 24 agentic auto-research tasks.
sents.zh: 如表 2 所示，所提出的基于技能的演化方法在 24 项智能体自动研究任务中的 19 项中，成功揭示了优于基础模型的后训练性能。

sents.en: In particular, our method achieves absolute performance gains of 32.00, 15.28, and 15.08 percentage points over the original base model on SWE-V, AIME, and Terminal-Bench 2.0, respectively.
sents.zh: 具体而言，我们的方法在 SWE-V、AIME 和 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上分别比原始基础模型实现了 32.00、15.28 和 15.08 个百分点的绝对性能提升。

sents.en: Moreover, skill-based evolving approach consistently outperforms context-passing evolving approach across all six benchmarks, increasing average performance from 28.42% to 31.91%.
sents.zh: 此外，基于技能的演化方法在所有六个基准测试中均持续优于上下文传递演化方法，将平均性能从 28.42% 提升至 31.91%。

sents.en: Notably, the proposed method avoids the performance degradation observed with context passing on GPQA Diamond.
sents.zh: 值得注意的是，所提出的方法避免了在 GPQA Diamond 上因上下文传递而出现的性能下降问题。

sents.en: The relative gains are particularly pronounced on SWE-P and Terminal-Bench 2.0, where average performance improves by 68.8% and 34.1%, respectively.
sents.zh: 相对增益在 SWE-P 和 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上尤为显著，平均性能分别提升了 68.8% 和 34.1%。

sents.en: Experimental findings suggest that continually accumulating operational experience to improve skills is particularly effective for tasks requiring complex procedural reasoning and tool interaction.
sents.zh: 实验结果表明，持续积累操作经验以提升技能，对于需要复杂流程推理和工具交互的任务尤其有效。

sents.en: The solid self-improvement observed in the auto-research scenario further demonstrates that distilling feedback from each iteration into the continually enriched skill experience provides an effective and reusable mechanism for adaptation.
sents.zh: 在自动研究场景中观察到的稳定自我提升进一步证明，将每次迭代的反馈提炼到持续丰富的技能经验中，为适应变化提供了一种有效且可重复使用的机制。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based agents combine reasoning, planning, memory, and tool use to solve complex tasks through iterative interaction. ReAct [ 19 ] established the widely adopted paradigm of interleaving reasoning with executable actions. Toolformer [ 20 ] and ToolLLM [ 21 ] further enabled LLMs to select and invoke external APIs, while Reflexion [ 22 ] and Voyager [ 23 ] introduced feedback-driven improvement and the accumulation of reusable behaviors. Complementary multi-agent frameworks, including AutoGen [ 24 ] and MetaGPT [ 25 ] , coordinate specialized agents through role assignment and structured communication. DSPy [ 26 ] instead provides declarative abstractions for composing and optimizing LLM programs. These approaches primarily optimize model interactions, execution policies, or agent workflows. Reusable capabilities are typically represented as prompts, traces, code snippets, or framework-specific modules, with limited support for independent versioning, evaluation, distribution, and maintenance.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过迭代交互，将推理、规划、记忆和工具使用相结合，以解决复杂任务。 ReAct [ 19 ] 确立了将推理与可执行动作交替进行的广泛采用的范式。 Toolformer [ 20 ] 和 ToolLLM [ 21 ] 进一步使大型语言模型能够选择和调用外部 API，而 Reflexion [ 22 ] 和 Voyager [ 23 ] 则引入了基于反馈的改进机制以及可重复使用行为的积累方法。 互补的多智能体框架，包括 AutoGen [ 24 ] 和 MetaGPT [ 25 ] ，通过角色分配和结构化通信来协调专业智能体。 相比之下，DSPy [ 26 ] 为构建和优化大型语言模型程序提供了声明式抽象方法。 这些方法主要优化模型交互、执行策略或智能体的工作流程。 可重复使用的能力通常以提示、轨迹、代码片段或框架特定模块的形式表示，但对独立版本控制、评估、分发和维护的支持有限。

paragraphs.en: Skill-based self-evolution converts accumulated experience into reusable and actionable behavioral abstractions. Trace2Skill [ 27 ] , AutoSkill [ 28 ] , and SkillX [ 29 ] derive transferable skills from execution traces and organize them into extensible skill libraries, allowing agents to reuse procedural knowledge without replaying complete trajectories. Since automatically induced skills may be redundant, brittle, or unreliable beyond their original tasks, closed-loop approaches such as CoEvoSkills [ 30 ] , Memento-Skills [ 31 ] , and SkillForge [ 32 ] couple skill generation with verification and deployment feedback to iteratively improve skill correctness, generality, and controllability. Extending this paradigm beyond private agent adaptation, SkillClaw [ 33 ] and EvoSkill [ 34 ] investigate population-level evolution over shared skill repositories, where validation, admission, versioning, and rollback are essential for maintaining the quality of collectively accumulated capabilities. Additionally, SkillRL [ 35 ] , D2Skill [ 36 ] , and XSkill [ 37 ] integrate automatic skill discovery with reinforcement learning, utility estimation, and hierarchical control, thereby enabling agents to jointly improve reusable procedures and policies. Agentic skill self-evolving holds considerable promise as a foundational paradigm for building autonomous agents, enabling them to continually expand and refine the behavioral capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 基于技能的自我演化将积累的经验转化为可重复使用且具备行动能力的行为抽象。 Trace2Skill [ 27 ]、AutoSkill [ 28 ] 和 SkillX [ 29 ] 从执行轨迹中提取可迁移的技能，并将其组织为可扩展的技能库，使智能体无需重演完整轨迹即可复用程序性知识。 由于自动生成的技能可能冗余、脆弱或超出原始任务范围后不可靠，因此 CoEvoSkills [ 30 ]、Memento-Skills [ 31 ] 和 SkillForge [ 32 ] 等闭环方法将技能生成与验证及部署反馈相结合，以迭代提升技能的准确性、通用性和可控性。 为将这一范式从智能体的私有适应扩展到更广泛场景，SkillClaw [ 33 ] 和 EvoSkill [ 34 ] 研究了基于共享技能库的群体级演化，其中验证、准入控制、版本管理和回滚对于维持集体积累能力的质量至关重要。 此外，SkillRL [ 35 ]、D2Skill [ 36 ] 和 XSkill [ 37 ] 将自动技能发现与强化学习、效用估计和分层控制相结合，从而让智能体能够协同优化可重复使用的程序和政策。 智能体的技能自我演化作为构建自主智能体的基础范式展现出巨大潜力，使其能够持续扩展并完善自身的行为能力。

paragraphs.en: We introduced Darwin-Claw, an environment-adaptive self-evolving framework designed to overcome the limitations of isolated and static LLM agents. To address the challenge of effectively accumulating and utilizing situational experience, we proposed a Hierarchical Experience Consolidation System that systematically attributes interaction failures and abstracts them into dynamic environment prototypes. Building upon this substrate, our Experience-Driven Agentic Holistic Evolution mechanism translates these consolidated experiences into actionable updates, driving the continuous refinement of both external operational skills and durable long-term memory. Practically, Darwin-Claw serves as a readily deployable system compatible with mainstream agent architectures, enabling not only personalized environmental perception but also the collective evolution of skill ecosystems across multiple users. Extensive evaluations on WildClawBench demonstrate that our framework significantly enhances task completion performance. Ultimately, Darwin-Claw establishes a principled and controllable pathway for the continuous, user-centric evolution of autonomous agents in complex, dynamic environments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Darwin-Claw——一个能够适应环境并自我演化的框架，旨在克服孤立且静态的 LLM 智能体的局限性。 为了解决有效积累和利用情境性经验的挑战，我们提出了一种分层经验整合系统，该系统能系统地归因于交互失败，并将其抽象为动态的环境原型。 基于这一基础，我们的“经验驱动的智能体整体演化”机制将这些整合后的经验转化为可执行更新，从而持续优化外部操作技能和持久的长期记忆。 在实际应用中，Darwin-Claw 是一个易于部署的系统，兼容主流智能体架构，不仅能实现个性化的环境感知，还能促进跨多个用户的技能生态系统的集体演化。 在 WildClawBench 上的广泛评估表明，我们的框架显著提升了任务完成性能。 最终，Darwin-Claw 为自主智能体在复杂动态环境中持续、以用户为中心的演化建立了一条有原则且可控的路径。
